headlines.title: 2분기 전기료 동결 가닥…조정 단가 ㎾h당 5원 유지
headlines.summary: 한국전력공사가 오는 21일 2분기 전기요금을 결정한다. 최근 4년간 누적 영업적자가 34.7조원 규모여서 인상요인은 여전하지만, 지난해 수익성이 다소 회복된 만큼 동결 가능성이 우세하다. '전기요금 동결' 가능성의 배경에는 최근 물가 상승 압박, 요금 결정의 키(Key)를 쥔 국내 정치 상황의 불확실성이 있다.

headlines.title: ‘ RIA ’ 오늘부터 개설, 서학개미 셈법 분주

key_headlines.title: Oil Imports Surge, Inflation Looms
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's crude oil imports jumped 27% in early March, signaling increased Middle East-driven inflation pressures despite robust semiconductor-led export growth.

key_headlines.title: Markets Plunge Amid Mideast Tensions
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate breached 1510, hitting a 17-year high, while the KOSPI index fell below 5500, triggering a trading halt, as Middle East conflict escalation rocked financial markets.

key_headlines.title: Government Unleashes Forex Stabilizers
key_headlines.summary: South Korea introduces 'three major emergency measures' to stabilize the won, which has weakened significantly against the dollar, aiming to counter the highest average exchange rate since the Asian Financial Crisis.

key_headlines.title: NATO Allies Unite for Hormuz
key_headlines.summary: NATO Secretary General announced that 22 nations, including South Korea and Japan, are uniting to ensure the free passage through the Strait of Hormuz amid rising geopolitical risks.

key_headlines.title: Korea to Release Oil Reserves, Curb Exports
key_headlines.summary: The South Korean government plans to release strategic oil reserves and restrict petroleum product exports by mid-April to address global oil price spikes and stabilize domestic supply due to the US-Iran conflict.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea is experiencing a severe economic "triple whammy" from surging oil prices, a weakening won, and escalating inflation, all intensified by Middle East tensions. Crude oil import values saw a significant increase, driving up domestic prices, while the won depreciated to a 17-year low against the dollar, pushing KOSPI sharply down and triggering trading halts. In response, the government is preparing to release strategic oil reserves and restrict petroleum product exports, along with implementing emergency measures to stabilize the exchange rate. Internationally, NATO allies, including South Korea and Japan, are consolidating efforts to ensure the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring the broad impact of geopolitical risks on global economic stability.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The escalating Middle East conflict and high oil prices are raising concerns about potential stagflation and high-interest rate risks, threatening South Korea's economic recovery. Experts warn that increased borrowing costs would likely reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, potentially hindering GDP growth. The newly nominated Bank of Korea Governor, Shin Hyun-song, is tasked with balancing market stability and economic vitality amidst these uncertainties, having previously advocated for preemptive rate hikes to control inflation. Expectations lean towards a potential interest rate freeze in April, as the central bank grapples with managing inflation amidst growth challenges and exchange rate volatility.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean financial markets plunged into chaos, with the KOSPI index dropping over 6% and triggering a sell-side circuit breaker, while the won-dollar exchange rate surged past 1510, marking a 17-year high. This market shock is attributed to the intensifying US-Iran conflict and renewed fears of US interest rate hikes. Foreign investors have significantly divested from Korean national bond futures, selling 13.1 trillion won over three months due to concerns over high exchange rates and inflation. Prolonged high oil prices are expected to exacerbate inflation and diminish hopes for rate cuts, with some market participants now even anticipating potential rate increases by the Federal Reserve, deepening the "Black Monday" scenario for the Korean stock market.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korean industrial giants are strategically pivoting to navigate economic uncertainties and secure future growth. LG Energy Solution is diversifying beyond EV batteries into large-scale ESS contracts and high-performance robot batteries, while developing battery diagnostic software. Kumho Petrochemical is focusing on high-value EV materials like SSBR, critical for electric vehicle tires. Hyundai Mobis is expanding its reach into automotive semiconductors and robotics, leveraging its robust manufacturing expertise to become a comprehensive mobility platform provider. Concurrently, Elon Musk announced the construction of a "Terafab" in Texas, a massive semiconductor factory for Tesla and SpaceX, aimed at achieving self-sufficiency in chip production amidst persistent supply chain concerns.
sections.Real Estate: Publicly assessed prices for certain Seoul multi-family homes, particularly those in redevelopment areas near the Han River, have reportedly doubled within a year, leading to increased comprehensive real estate tax liabilities for owners. For instance, some units in a nearly 50-year-old complex now exceed the 1.2 billion won threshold for high-value housing. New apartment offerings, such as "Acro de Seocho," are launching with high average prices of 78 million won per 3.3 square meters, reflecting the premium for new construction in prime locations. Moreover, renewal contracts for Seoul apartments now constitute nearly half of all lease agreements this year, exceeding 50% in March, driven by rising jeonse prices and the impact of land transaction permit zones.
sections.International Economy: Wall Street is reportedly urging the White House to intervene in the escalating conflict between former President Trump and Federal Reserve Chair Powell, as Trump's actions continue to destabilize markets. Powell, emphasizing the Fed's independence, referenced Paul Volcker's resolve against inflation amidst political pressure, even as the Fed recently maintained interest rates. Concerns are mounting over high energy prices potentially driving overall inflation, and a warning of a "bank run" in Middle Eastern banks, with up to $307 billion at risk, underscores the severe financial instability. Market expectations for Fed rate cuts are diminishing, with some analysts now anticipating potential rate hikes later this year due to persistent inflation and geopolitical uncertainties.
sections.AI & Economy: Naver is aggressively pursuing a global platform transformation by integrating AI agents across all its services, leveraging AI and data-driven competitiveness to uncover new business opportunities. The company plans substantial investments in e-commerce to boost delivery capabilities and will utilize AI infrastructure and digital transformation as key long-term growth drivers. In the public sector, the Korea Local Information Research & Development Institute is launching an "AX Competency Enhancement Special Lecture" series to improve local government officials' AI and data utilization skills and reduce policy disparities. Separately, Wooriro, having completed a technology transfer, is targeting the ultra-high-speed optical detector market for next-generation AI data centers, aiming to commercialize 400Gbps optical detector semiconductor devices by 2027 to meet the demands of generative AI and large-scale GPU clusters.
sections.Others: The intensified Middle East conflict, following former President Trump's "ultimatum," has caused significant volatility in international oil prices. Paradoxically, gold prices, typically a safe-haven asset, have declined by nearly 11% last week amidst concerns of a prolonged Iran conflict and inflationary pressures. US public opinion shows a mixed response, with disapproval of Trump's handling of the Iran war, yet also a reluctance to see the current Iranian regime remain in power. South Korea's Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, Kim Jung-kwan, is actively engaging in "resource diplomacy" by holding meetings with major resource-rich nations like Saudi Arabia and the UAE to stabilize crude oil and natural gas supplies amidst the deteriorating Middle East situation and risks to the Strait of Hormuz.
